invariants.invariant: TypeOrmUnitOfWork.withTransaction() reentrancy: a nested withTransaction() call joins the already-active QueryRunner instead of opening a second connection/transaction.
invariants.enforcement: TypeOrmQueryRunnerContext.get() check at the top of withTransaction() before creating a QueryRunner (libs/platform/database/src/typeorm-unit-of-work.ts)

cases.operation: nested withTransaction() inside an active outer transaction, success
cases.expected: createQueryRunner called exactly once; single commit; single release
cases.test: libs/platform/database/test/typeorm-unit-of-work.spec.ts > 'joins an already-active transaction instead of opening a second connection, and lets the outer call own commit/rollback'

cases.expected: single rollback on the outer QueryRunner; no independent inner rollback/commit
cases.test: libs/platform/database/test/typeorm-unit-of-work.spec.ts > 'rolls back the single outer transaction when a nested withTransaction call throws'

invariants.invariant: Database contextual state (active QueryRunner) is scoped per root/nested runtime context and cleaned up exception-safely; it never leaks across concurrent executions or past the transaction.
invariants.enforcement: TypeOrmQueryRunnerContext.run() opens a runtimeContext.runNested({ifNested:'inherit'}) scope around the callback (libs/platform/database/src/typeorm-unit-of-work.ts); RuntimeContextService.runNested/runRoot always open a genuinely separate AsyncLocalStorage frame (libs/platform/context/src/runtime-context.service.ts)

cases.expected: TypeOrmQueryRunnerContext.get() returns undefined again once withTransaction() resolves
cases.test: libs/platform/database/test/typeorm-unit-of-work.spec.ts > 'commits and makes the QueryRunner available to work() via the context'

cases.operation: withTransaction() with no active parent CLS context
cases.expected: a temporary root context is opened for the duration of the transaction and closed after
cases.test: libs/platform/database/test/typeorm-unit-of-work.spec.ts > 'works with no active parent CLS context (opens a temporary root, cleans up after)'

cases.operation: withTransaction() with an active parent CLS context carrying correlation/request state
cases.expected: correlation/request sibling namespaces stay visible inside the transaction, and the previous (unset) database slice is restored after, with no leaked QueryRunner
cases.test: libs/platform/database/test/typeorm-unit-of-work.spec.ts > 'preserves correlation/request sibling namespaces of an active parent CLS context, and restores the previous database slice after'

cases.operation: two concurrent TypeOrmQueryRunnerContext.run() calls with different QueryRunners
cases.expected: each execution observes only its own QueryRunner throughout, including after an await
cases.test: libs/platform/database/test/typeorm-unit-of-work.spec.ts > 'isolates concurrent transactions — one never sees the other's QueryRunner'

invariants.invariant: Generic runtime-context nested scope: a scoped override never mutates the parent-owned object for the slice it replaces, and always restores the parent's own value after the callback settles (success or throw).
invariants.enforcement: RuntimeContextService.runNested() always opens a new AsyncLocalStorage frame (via ClsService.run with an explicit ifNested policy) rather than mutating the currently active store in place (libs/platform/context/src/runtime-context.service.ts)

cases.operation: nested scoped override replaces a namespace, then the callback returns normally
cases.expected: parent's own object reference for that namespace is unchanged; sibling namespaces preserved
cases.test: libs/platform/context/test/runtime-context.service.spec.ts > 'inherit: preserves sibling namespaces and restores the parent's own value after success'

cases.operation: nested scoped override replaces a namespace, then the callback throws
cases.expected: parent's own object reference for that namespace is unchanged after the throw propagates
cases.test: libs/platform/context/test/runtime-context.service.spec.ts > 'inherit: restores the parent value after the callback throws'
